d:
After their defeat by Sonic, the Knight of the Wind, Sir Gawain (Knuckles), Sir Lancelot (Shadow), and Sir Percival (Blaze)—all members of the Knights of the Round Table—are desperate to reclaim their honor and grow stronger to protect their king, Arthur. They decide to seek out the mysterious "Red Knight" (Rouge), who is known for her unconventional methods of empowering others.
But they soon realize that every gift comes with a price.

Story & Story board by Lummh
Illustrated by dArtagnyan
